violations.text: Raw animal foods (shelled eggs) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (condiments and hotdogs) in the walk-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. New Violation. Correct By: 07/28/2026

Working containers of (dry ingredients ) are not labeled with the common name of the food. Working containers holding food or food ingredients that are removed from their original packages, such as flour, herbs, salt, sugar, and spices must be labeled with the common name of the food. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/28/2026

The presence of (roaches and fruit flies ) is not controlled as evidenced by (live and dead roaches on glue traps and live activity of fruit flies ). The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. New Violation. Correct By: 07/28/2026
Knives and utensils was observed being stored between wall and metal paneling. New Violation. Correct By: 07/28/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the (prep units, prep shelves, handwashing sink, and 3 bay sink ) have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 07/28/2026

The floors throughout the facility have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 07/28/2026

The presence of (flies) is not controlled as evidenced by (live activity ). The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. New Violation. Correct By: 07/30/2024
